tasks.label: Build Documentation
tasks.detail: Render the Doxygen + Doxygen Awesome HTML docs into ./html (gitignored). Runs the rpg_os_docs CMake target so any IDE or terminal can use the same command.

tasks.label: Build Web Demo (WASM + rulesets)
tasks.command: mkdir -p web/demo/wasm web/demo/rulesets && wasm/build.sh && cp wasm/package/dist/rpg-os-universal.{js,wasm} web/demo/wasm/ && cp rulesets/dnd5e_srd.json rulesets/tde5e_core.json web/demo/rulesets/
tasks.detail: Build the universal engine to WASM (wasm/build.sh — requires the Emscripten SDK on PATH) and copy the WASM module + rulesets into web/demo/ (gitignored).

tasks.label: Generate Web Demo leaderboards
tasks.command: mkdir -p web/demo/data && cmake --build build --target rpg_os_example_fight && python3 scripts/elo_ranking.py --ruleset rulesets/dnd5e_srd.json --seed 20260817 --rounds 40 --games 20 --jobs 4 --initial 1000 --json web/demo/data/dnd5e_srd_elo.json && python3 scripts/elo_ranking.py --ruleset rulesets/tde5e_core.json --seed 20260817 --rounds 40 --games 20 --jobs 4 --initial 1000 --json web/demo/data/tde5e_core_elo.json
tasks.detail: Build the native fight binary and generate the ELO leaderboards into web/demo/data/ (gitignored; same fixed seed/flags as CI). Optional — the demo still loads without them.

tasks.label: Serve Web Demo
tasks.detail: Serve the ELO Arena demo at http://localhost:8000 (background task — fetch() needs http, not file://). Build the assets first, then stop it from the terminal.

tasks.label: Run Web Demo
tasks.detail: One click: build the WASM assets + rulesets, generate the ELO leaderboards, then serve the demo at http://localhost:8000 (background). Requires the Emscripten SDK on PATH for the WASM build.
